pre_run_hypotheses: The frozen explicit input imports, exports 22 authored populated tables exactly, converts with zero errors, calculates and writes a valid report.

Individual physical stock and backorder ledgers do not mix between BASE-01 and BASE-02; depot service and failed-item repair reconcile.

decision_rule: If import/export, conversion, event ledgers or report fail, retain a sealed diagnostic and repair in a new version. Accept parity only if a separate replay confirms the two arms' compared values; otherwise publish only a precisely bounded discrepancy or exclude.
limits: One fixed-seed, two-base explicit comparator; no statistical equivalence or same-ID claim.
No GSTID default or one-base override; E12.var02 through E12.var04 remain open.
No differing support scheme, LEVL/LINDX layout, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
